notes.title: Please Duology is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41199810/0095ae00589dd8b3897eab2ead8f4979371d84d0.png[/img]

Today is the release of our new short game, Please Duology. A compilation of two short, atmosphere-heavy previously released games, it is a dark, hopeless experience that can be completed in under an hour.

Included are the two original games, [i]Please[/i] and [i]Please Follow[/i], as well as new supplemental material called [i]Please Read[/i], which contains documents to be unlocked while playing the two games, and should add a little more clarity into the narrative universe of [i]Please[/i].

Buy it now and have 10% off, as a release discount. 

[i]Please Duology[/i] is the last re-release from Somewhat Software in 2021. This year, our goal has been to revamp and re-release our old catalog of titles on Steam, and we conclude this initial effort with this title. From now on, expect new things from Somewhat in 2022. See you there!
